University Institute of Engineering and Technology

Project Staff Requirement
Applications are invited for the appointment of Project Technical Support-III -01 in ICMR
funded project entitled “Tele-Health Screening and Management for Non-Communicable
Diseases” for a period of 1 year OR co-terminous with project depending upon the satisfactory
performance of the candidate at University Institute of Engineering and Technology (UIET),
Sector-25, Panjab University, Chandigarh.

Responsibilities:
 Responsible for maintaining accounting records, checking the financial documents.
 Keeping track of transactions, expenditures, processing of purchase order.
 Coordinating with the field staff for patient data compilation and feedback
 Making accounts-related reports, managing and Compiling Budgets as per the rules.
 Handling the communication with various stakeholders
 Providing support to administrative related tasks in the accounts department.
 Performing tasks like, keeping track of monetary transactions, assisting in
administrative activities.
 Stock Maintenance and any other work assigned by PI/Co-PIs.
The incumbent is expected to work on Saturdays/Sundays and maybe on holidays also for
any project exigency. Date, time and venue of the interview will be conveyed to the eligible/
shortlisted candidates through email or phone. No separate call letters will be issued for the
interview. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for attending the interview.
Candidates can apply till 18th July, 2025 through Google form Link
https://forms.gle/e1VAgQeqzFdfgfz19
Dr. Harish Kumar
Principal Investigator and Professor, CSE
UIET, Panjab University, Chandigarh
